note: Small privately run RV park on US-54 (W Kansas Ave) on the west side of downtown Greensburg: gravel pull-throughs behind the laundry building, a short walk to the Big Well. No signage and no website; call ahead. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $30 a night in May-September 2026 (RV Life reviews); the town's tourism listing still says $20. --Claude
summary: Not city-run: a small commercial park (Campendium 'privately owned', RV Life 'commercial', owners named in reviews); no operator web page, only the tourism listing ($20, 15 spaces 30/50 A, restrooms, laundry). Fee 20 -> 30 camper-reported (RV Life 5/8/9-2026). Wi-Fi cleared. Ownership lead local -> private. Google 4.2/95, RV Life 4.0/19. Pin fine.
flags: OWNERSHIP lead (apply.py doesn't write it): local -> private.
